Name: WET_ASPECT_PARAM_ST
Description: Wet look of a character: colour, metallic and shininess values that override the surface's own by the given rates. Row 0 is None.

Fields.Name: Base Color: R
Fields.Description: Red of the wet surface colour (0-255).

Fields.Name: Base Color: G
Fields.Description: Green of the wet surface colour (0-255).

Fields.Name: Base Color: B
Fields.Description: Blue of the wet surface colour (0-255).

Fields.Name: Base Color Override Rate
Fields.Description: How strongly the wet colour replaces the surface colour (0-1). 0: colour unchanged.

Fields.Name: Metallic
Fields.Description: Metallic value of the wet surface (0-255).

Fields.Name: Metallic Override Rate
Fields.Description: How strongly the wet metallic value replaces the surface's own (0-1). 0: unchanged.

Fields.Name: Shininess Override Rate
Fields.Description: How strongly the wet shininess replaces the surface's own (0-1). 0: unchanged.

Fields.Name: Shininess
Fields.Description: Shininess (gloss) of the wet surface (0-255). Higher is glossier.
